_comment: plan-generic-kill-quests.md C2 — the Emberkeeper's kill quest, and THE FIRST HUMAN-TARGET KILL QUEST in the game (a first the PO should see in play; GiantSpider L14 x5 at 12.6-15.4u is the recorded fallback in the plan's §8). Target measured: 11 plain Bandit spawns (L12 x6 + L13 x5) within 9.8-21 units of the Emberkeeper at (34.5, -19.6) — the objective counts the Bandit SPECIES only, so BanditRanged/BanditPyromancer/BanditHealer kills do not credit it. Reward on the turn-in row (emberkeeper.json): 1250 XP = the L9 half-level rule splitting the L12/L13 pair. Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02: no lore or stylized quest text yet).
